changeSet.author: pkomena

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM clinlims.organization WHERE fhir_uuid IS NULL

changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.organization SET fhir_uuid = (substr(h, 1, 8) || '-' || substr(h, 9, 4) || '-4' || substr(h, 14, 3) || '-' || substr('89ab', (get_byte(decode(substr(h, 17, 2), 'hex'), 0) % 4) + 1, 1) || substr(h, 18, 3) || '-' || substr(h, 21, 12))::uuid, lastupdated = now() FROM (SELECT id AS oid, md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || id::text) AS h FROM clinlims.organization WHERE fhir_uuid IS NULL) g WHERE id = g.oid;
